questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring packaging and print design. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to packaging and print design, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with packaging and print design. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with packaging and print design. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: design a functional net that folds correctly; choose appropriate materials with sustainability considered; create effective surface graphics with clear information hierarchy; build a working prototype.
